root_cause: The reverse PC->function lookup for sparse func-kind namespaces conflated a 'local offset within this namespace's slice of sparse index space' with the 'global/absolute SparseIndex' needed to index the single shared `sparse_indices` PrimaryMap across all namespaces. The per-namespace base offset (`sparse_starts[ns_idx]`) that the forward-building code (`CompiledFunctionsTableBuilder`) uses to lay out the sparse_indices table was never added back in on the lookup path.
